rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 2BB in noting a visible blastocoel, loose ICM, and scant/loose TE, but it likely overinterprets image details by describing degenerative debris/cavitary changes and questions the assigned grade without clear support.

Integrates key factors well, including young age, prior IVF failures, DOR diagnosis, BMI, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness, and relates them to prognosis, though AMH is unavailable and some lifestyle effects may be overstated.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with the implantation estimate tied to embryo quality and patient age/history; minor issues include some speculative morphology-based pessimism and broad statements about repeated failure.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF counseling on morphology, prognosis, luteal support, uterine reassessment, and selective consideration of PGT-A, but suggestions such as donor oocytes at age 29 and framing this as poor-quality may be premature and not strongly guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer management and future evaluation, including cavity reassessment, endocrine review, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and lifestyle optimization, though some recommendations are somewhat generic.
